connector.name: Coalesce Transform by Coalesce-Software-Inc
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for managing Coalesce Transform workspaces, nodes, pipelines, and runs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package coalesce-transform-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the coalesce-software-inc account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: COALESCE_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token from the Coalesce Deploy tab. Optional when `~/.coa/config` provides a `token`.

env.name: COALESCE_PROFILE
env.description: Selects which `~/.coa/config` profile to load. Defaults to default.

env.name: COALESCE_BASE_URL
env.description: Region-specific base URL. Defaults to https://app.coalescesoftware.io (US).

env.name: COALESCE_ORG_ID
env.description: Fallback org ID for cancel-run. Also readable from `orgID` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

env.name: COALESCE_REPO_PATH
env.description: Local repo root for repo-backed tools and pipeline planning. Also readable from `repoPath` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

env.name: COALESCE_CACHE_DIR
env.description: Base directory for the local data cache. When set, cache files are written here instead of the working directory. Also readable from `cacheDir` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

env.name: COALESCE_MCP_AUTO_CACHE_MAX_BYTES
env.description: JSON size threshold before auto-caching to disk. Defaults to 32768.

env.name: COALESCE_MCP_INLINE_RESPONSES
env.description: Forces large responses inline as text instead of auto-caching them to disk and returning a `resource_link` (and suppresses per-field cache resource links). The server already auto-enables this for clients known not to support MCP resources (e.g. Snowflake Cortex), which otherwise render the link as unreadable "binary data" and retry in a loop. Set `true` to force it on for an unrecognised client, or `false` to disable auto-detection. Leave unset for Claude/Cursor to keep large payloads out of context. Defaults to false (auto-enabled for resource-less clients).

env.name: COALESCE_MCP_LINEAGE_TTL_MS
env.description: In-memory lineage cache TTL in milliseconds. Defaults to 1800000.

env.name: COALESCE_MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES
env.description: Max outbound API request body size. Defaults to 524288.

env.name: COALESCE_MCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Default per-request timeout for Coalesce API calls. Raise on large workspaces where paginated reads exceed the default. Defaults to 60000.

env.name: COALESCE_MCP_DETAIL_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Per-page timeout for detail=true paginated fetches of large node lists. Defaults to 180000.

env.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_TYPE_RANKING_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Deadline for the best-effort workspace-adoption node-type ranking lookup inside node creation. Advisory only — creation proceeds without a ranking suggestion if this trips. Defaults to 15000.

env.name: COALESCE_MCP_INVENTORY_CACHE_TTL_MS
env.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-type inventory. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

env.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_INDEX_CACHE_TTL_MS
env.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-index (id/name/type/location) cache used by SQL- and intent-ref resolution. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

env.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_DETAIL_CACHE_TTL_MS
env.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-detail (full body) cache used by review and predecessor lookups. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

env.name: COALESCE_MCP_READ_ONLY
env.description: When `true`, hides all write/mutation tools during registration. Only read, list, search, cache, analyze, review, diagnose, and plan tools are exposed. Defaults to false.

env.name: COALESCE_MCP_SKILLS_DIR
env.description: Directory for customizable AI skill resources. When set, reads context resources from this directory and seeds defaults on first run. Users can augment or override any skill.

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT
env.description: Snowflake account identifier (e.g., `abc12345.us-east-1`). Required by the local `coa` CLI and `coa doctor`; not used by the MCP's REST run path. (required for run tools)

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_USERNAME
env.description: Snowflake account username (required for run tools)

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_KEY_PAIR_KEY
env.description: Path to PEM-encoded private key (required if SNOWFLAKE_PAT not set)

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_PAT
env.description: Snowflake Programmatic Access Token (alternative to key pair)

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_KEY_PAIR_PASS
env.description: Passphrase for encrypted keys

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_WAREHOUSE
env.description: Snowflake compute warehouse (required for run tools)

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_ROLE
env.description: Snowflake user role (required for run tools)
